### ✅ Submission Checklist (Enforced by Automated CI)
- [ ] I created my package entry in `content/showcase/<category>/<slug>/index.md` using the required frontmatter fields.
- [ ] I added or updated my Developer Profile in `data/developers/<my-github-username>.yaml` with my avatar, bio, and repository links.
- [ ] **No Heavy Files Committed:** My `.htheme`, `.htrans`, or `.hwidget` binary is hosted on my own GitHub Repository / Releases (`download_url`), and my preview image(s) are compressed under **300 KB**.
- [ ] **No Self-Assigned Badges:** I did **not** edit `data/showcase_badges.json` or add `badges:` to frontmatter (Curation badges like `dev_approved` and `community_approved` are awarded by maintainer review and community upvotes).
- [ ] I tested importing my package in HyperBridge (`v0.6.0+`).
